## Shared dataset consumption

These datasets are governed by the CDT Steward. The Forecasting Team's role
is Custodian only.

| Dataset | Shared Asset Register entry | Team Custodian contact |

| Gauge metadata | Shared Asset Register | [Named Custodian] |
| Catchment shapefiles | Shared Asset Register | [Named Custodian] |
